grades.quote: The jump target address of the above two branch instructions is to logical left shift the 21-bit immediate `offs21` in the instruction code by 2 bits and then sign extension, and the resulting offset value is added to the `PC` of the branch instruction.
grades.reason: Covers BEQZ/BNEZ, not BEQ. It gives an analogous PC-relative target calculation (offset shifted left 2, sign-extended, added to PC) but with a 21-bit offs21 field. BEQ uses a 16-bit offset and this passage doesn't say so, so it is only auxiliary.
